The Cardinal were led by fifth year head coach [[Jerod Haase]] and are a member of the [[Pac-12 Conference]]. They originally planned to play their home games at [[Maples Pavilion]], but due to [[COVID-19 pandemic in the San Francisco Bay Area|COVID-19 regulations]] by [[Santa Clara County, California]], they cancelled five games and then moved the rest of their home games to [[Kaiser Permanente Arena]] in [[Santa Cruz, California]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019-20 Stanford Cardinal men's basketball team|Cardinal]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 20–11, 9–9 in [[2019–20 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 play]] to finish in seventh place. They lost in the first round of the [[2020 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to the tenth seed [[2019-20 California Golden Bears men's basketball team|California]] 63–51, finishing their year because of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], cancelling post-season tournaments. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" style="font-size:100%;" border="1" !
